intro: Every major trophy he lifted, with the final, the route and his part in it. International trophies first, Chennai Super Kings second.

international.title: ICC World Twenty20
international.final: Beat Pakistan by 5 runs, Johannesburg, 24 September
international.route: Group: tied v Pakistan (won bowl-out), beat Scotland (abandoned). Super 8s: lost to New Zealand, beat England (Yuvraj's six sixes), beat South Africa. Semi-final: beat Australia by 15 runs (Yuvraj 70 off 30).
international.dhoni: Captain. 154 runs in 6 innings; the Joginder Sharma over.
international.squad: Gambhir, Sehwag, Uthappa, Yuvraj, Dhoni, Rohit, Pathan, Harbhajan, Joginder, RP Singh, Sreesanth, Agarkar, Dinesh Karthik, Chawla, Pathan (Y)

international.title: Commonwealth Bank Series
international.final: Beat Australia 2–0 in the best-of-three finals: Sydney (by 6 wickets) and Brisbane (by 9 runs), 2 and 4 March
international.route: Tri-series with Australia and Sri Lanka; India qualified second.
international.dhoni: Captain; Tendulkar's 117* at Sydney was the series' defining innings.

international.title: Asia Cup
international.final: Beat Sri Lanka by 81 runs, Dambulla, 24 June
international.route: Beat Bangladesh, Pakistan; lost to Sri Lanka in the group; Dinesh Karthik 66 in the final.
international.dhoni: Captain; 38 in the final. India's first Asia Cup since 1995.

international.title: ICC Cricket World Cup
international.final: Beat Sri Lanka by 6 wickets, Mumbai, 2 April
international.route: Group: beat Bangladesh, tied v England, beat Ireland, Netherlands, West Indies; lost to South Africa. Quarter-final: beat Australia by 5 wickets, Ahmedabad. Semi-final: beat Pakistan by 29 runs, Mohali.
international.dhoni: Captain. 91* off 79 in the final, player of the match. 241 runs in the tournament.
international.squad: Sehwag, Tendulkar, Gambhir, Kohli, Yuvraj, Dhoni, Raina, Harbhajan, Zaheer, Munaf, Nehra, Ashwin, Yusuf Pathan, Sreesanth, Chawla

international.title: ICC Champions Trophy
international.final: Beat England by 5 runs (20 overs a side), Edgbaston, 23 June
international.route: Group: beat South Africa, West Indies, Pakistan. Semi-final: beat Sri Lanka by 8 wickets, Cardiff. Unbeaten.
international.dhoni: Captain. The treble: the only captain to win all three ICC white-ball events.
international.squad: Dhawan (player of the tournament), Rohit, Kohli, Karthik, Raina, Dhoni, Jadeja, Ashwin, Bhuvneshwar, Ishant, Umesh, Yadav, Vinay, Murali Vijay, Irfan Pathan

international.title: Celkon Mobile Cup (tri-series)
international.final: Beat Sri Lanka by 1 wicket, Port of Spain, 11 July
international.route: Tri-series with West Indies and Sri Lanka.

international.title: Asia Cup (T20)
international.final: Beat Bangladesh by 8 wickets, Mirpur, 6 March
international.route: Beat Bangladesh, Pakistan, Sri Lanka, UAE.

franchise.title: Indian Premier League

franchise.dhoni: Captain; CSK qualified on the last league day.
